description: This file defines a class `DAverage` that implements the database AVERAGE function for spreadsheet calculations, specifically calculating the average of filtered database columns based on criteria.

classes.name: DAverage
classes.description: Implements the DAVERAGE database function which calculates the average of database column values matching specified criteria.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Calculates the average of a filtered database column based on the provided criteria, returning an Excel error if the field is invalid.
